items.title: Mona Hinton interviewed by Milt Fillius and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: So but the Basies and us we were friends and we were neighbors

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you about the Basie band. There were obviously some characters in the Basie band, and I was interviewing another one of the people and asking, you know, they were more than just musicians who could play the notes. They were personalities. They were characters. Can you tell us some of the either more funny things that happened or some of the more poignant things that happened in the Basie band amongst the characters?

Well you see I never traveled with the Basie band. See Milton was with Calloway for about 15 or 16 years. So I was always with the Cab Calloway band. So but the Basies and us we were friends and we were neighbors, and I frequently, well Catherine loved, they had a beautiful backyard with an Olympic-sized swimming pool and whatnot. And she loved to give parties for a lot of charitable organizations. And I do remember on one occasion that Milton, and Bill, I call him Bill, but Basie would come over to our house,…
I was going to say, what about some funny stories or poignant tales about the Calloway group?
